# ThinkingOrbsKit (vendored)

SwiftUI port of [thinking-orbs](https://libraries.dev/orbs) by Jakub Antalik, MIT.
Source: `packages/thinking-orbs/ports/ios/ThinkingOrbsKit` in
https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev at commit `ea001e3469e810e8a3e42df072cdb61e4a10c5ef`.

The same engine runs in the node's web dashboard and in the Expo app, so all
three clients draw identical orbs. To update, copy `Sources/ThinkingOrbsKit`
from a newer commit and update the commit above.
